_public_export.scope: Historical claims and verification records retain their original scope. Priority 1 cyclicity is even L2 only; full-ground capture and RH remain open.

scope: Phase II targeted primary-source verification after internal construction; not exhaustive literature search

records.title: A Spectral Interpretation of the Zeros of the Constant Term of Certain Eisenstein Series
records.claim_used: Modular Eisenstein constant term and cut-off Laplacian, not Riemann RH
records.assumptions: Modular arithmetic surface; cut-off parameter in stated range; spectral parameter differs from zeta argument by factor 2; center normalization excluded from application
records.verified_independently: PARTIAL: boundary coefficient and direct consequences C1–C7; not entire scattering theory
records.notes: Primary research manuscript. Root and two independent agents audited arithmetic, cancellation, domains and limits. Center s=1/2 special normalization was not used.

records.title: The Riemann hypothesis for certain integrals of Eisenstein series
records.claim_used: Prior occurrence and scope of different constant-term zero theorem
records.exact_theorem: Constant-term zero theorem for y>=1, with possible real exceptions
records.assumptions: Specific Eisenstein integral or constant-term family; not the Riemann xi zero set
records.verified_independently: PARTIAL: coefficient independently derived; original zero theorem not reproved
records.notes: Abstract and author note https://www.math.titech.ac.jp/top/~msuzuki/shizuoka_2004_2.pdf equations (1)–(4) checked; no claim of exhaustive paper audit.

records.title: The de Bruijn–Newman constant is non-negative
records.claim_used: Known threshold existence and nonnegative lower bound; all negative repo times have nonreal zeros
records.exact_theorem: Section 1 equations (1)–(4), Theorem 1.1; classical upper bound cited there
records.peer_reviewed: YES, Forum of Mathematics Pi 8 (2020), e6
records.verified_independently: NO for Theorem 1.1; normalization and local compactification independently checked
records.notes: Known input only. No new proof of threshold nonnegativity; Lambda=0 remains RH-equivalent.

records.title: The Laguerre inequality and the distribution of zeros of entire functions
records.claim_used: Prior occurrence of complex Laguerre/Herglotz criterion
records.assumptions: Real entire function of specified product/growth class
records.verified_independently: PARTIAL: actual xi Herglotz iff RH directly rederived using paired product
records.notes: No use as unconditional positivity of actual xi; cycle18 prior obstruction is acknowledged.

records.title: Spectral asymptotics for canonical systems
records.authors: Jonathan Eckhardt; Aleksey Kostenko; Gerald Teschl
records.claim_used: Conditions of canonical inverse theorem and convergence dictionary
records.assumptions: Herglotz input / positive trace-normalized Hamiltonians already supplied
records.verified_independently: NO for inverse theorem; signs and conditional Riccati/model formulas checked
records.notes: Does not turn an arbitrary prime germ into Herglotz input; no arithmetic Hamiltonian constructed.

records.title: On the Number of Primes Less Than a Given Magnitude
records.authors: Bernhard Riemann; English translation David R. Wilkins
records.exact_theorem: Translation text p.3 / PDF p.4 and following page
records.assumptions: Standard full Gaussian theta sum and analytic continuation
records.peer_reviewed: Historical primary publication, English translation inspected
records.verified_independently: PARTIAL: lattice Mellin formula and modular domain calculations rederived
records.notes: DLMF 20.7.32, 25.4.3–4, 25.5.13–14 used to check modern conventions. No claim that modularity proves RH.
